why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Both removed handlers were only partly preserved, so both are restored in this overlay. renderClouds HEAD: CloudRendererMixin (CloudRenderer.render) misses dimensions whose DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds draws the clouds, which 1.21.1's HEAD cancel also skipped; eca$skipOccludingClouds now cancels lambda$addCloudsPass$6 at its renderClouds call (the clouds pass runs after the main pass, so the flag is final). renderSky TAIL: 1.21.3 adds no sky pass when isFoggyAt (the Nether) or with SkyType NONE, so the AFTER_SKY GlobalSkyboxHook never drew there, though 1.21.1's TAIL did; it also drew over a custom renderSky, where 1.21.1 returned before TAIL. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass now adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main before addMainPass, with the FOG_SKY parameters, skipped when the custom renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky), and with an identity PoseStack because the pass runs after renderLevel pushed the view matrix onto the model-view stack; GlobalSkyboxHook's AFTER_SKY handler stands down via passOwned. renderEntity HEAD/RETURN and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay.
